title: DongCheng 20V Cordless Drilling Machine, 40Nm Torque, 350W Copper Motor, 18+1 Settings, 2-Speed 0-1500 RPM, 2.0Ah Battery and Charger, 16Pcs Drill Accessories for Professional & Home Use
description: 【Powerful 350W Copper Motor & 40Nm Torque】The cordless drilling machine with 350W copper motor copper motor have a longer lifespan, suitable for long-term operations in high temperature weather.40Nm high torque can easily drill holes on walls, wood, metal, plastic and masonry. 【Precision Control: 2-Speed Transmission & 18+1 Clutch】Featuring 2-speed (0-400RPM / 0-1500RPM) and 18+1 torque settings, this drill driver ensures precise control for both screw driving and drilling tasks, making it ideal for DIY projects as well as more demanding applications. 【20V 2.0Ah Lithium Battery】Cordless drill driver equipped with charge indicator and 1pc battery offers extended runtime for household tasks. 【Flexible Shaft & LED Light】The cordless drill machine includes a flexible shaft bit extension and a built-in LED light, making working in tight, dark spaces easier. 【1*2000mAh Battery & Safety Protection】Cordless drilling machine with 2000mAh battery provides 33% more run time than a 1500mAh batteryallowing you to drive through 800 screws on a full charge or drill through a 30mm thick wooden board for 100 times.Great Value Addition: These batteries are compatible with the Dongcheng 20V platform, offering flexibility if you plan to expand your tool collection in the future. 【What will You Get】Cordless drill machine x 1, 2.0Ah Li-ion battery x 1, charger x 1, Flexible Shaft x 1, Screwdriver Bits x 11, Drill Bits x 4, Expansion Screws x 30.
